name: Collaborator Recruitment
description: A complete collaborator recruitment application with conversational AI and traditional form modes. Perfect for finding co-founders, partners, or team members for your startup or project.
summary: Recruit collaborators with AI-powered conversations or traditional forms

inputs.description: Area of interest (product_design, engineering, integrations, undecided)
What the candidate has built that they're proud of
Why the candidate is interested in this project

outputs.description: MongoDB document ID of the saved submission
Whether owner notification email was sent

sideEffects.description: Saves candidate submission to MongoDB collection
Sends notification email to the project owner

events.name: submission.created
events.description: Emitted when a new collaborator application is submitted

events.name: notification.sent
events.description: Emitted when owner notification email is sent

instructions.import: This template creates a complete collaborator recruitment page with both conversational AI mode and traditional form mode. Use it to find co-founders, partners, or team members for your project.
setup: 1. Import the template bundle using the NetPad import API or UI
2. Configure your MongoDB connection in Settings → Connections
3. Configure your email integration in Settings → Integrations
4. Update the notification email in the workflow to your email address
5. Customize the form fields to match your collaboration requirements
6. Update the conversational config context with your project details
9. Create a landing page similar to /collaborate or embed the form directly
features: Dual-mode intake: AI conversational chat OR traditional form
Deep-dive conversational AI that learns about candidates naturally
10 carefully designed fields covering background, interest, and availability
Validation for meaningful responses (min character requirements)
Automatic owner notification on new submissions
MongoDB storage for all submissions with conversation metadata
Dark theme optimized for marketing pages
customization: Update the 'lanes' (collaboration areas) to match your needs
Customize the conversational persona and topics
Adjust validation rules (min lengths, required fields)
Add additional fields for your specific requirements
